subject: Fix DisplayAsSIBytes test (#216)
reason: The change modifies a single assertion in vmsdk/testing/utils_test.cc, changing EXPECT_EQ(buffer[1], -1) to EXPECT_EQ(buffer[1], '\xff') to fix the test under platforms where char is unsigned. It touches only test code: no module source, command handling, indexing, replication or persistence path changes, so there is no runtime behaviour to exercise and no scenario can reach the change.
